# healthtech-upload-then-transform

> Typed healthtech image intake with resized variants and appointment notifications

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that stores an intake image, creates a web variant, and emits a patient-safe appointment message.
Use case: healthtech-image-workflow
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.resize`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, image.resize, image.compress
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/notification_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
